title: Archiving a predecessor letter section counts as wish erasure
desc: handoff-wish-verdict.sh treats moving a predecessor's wish paragraphs to a sidecar file as WISH ERASED, not as a legitimate fat-md-growth remedy, unless every named wish is separately re-answered with a real manifest row
steps: Moving an old letter section wholesale to a sidecar deletes its wish paragraphs from the tracked letter, which the wish-erasure check reads as work still owed unless a manifest row answers each one individually

The safe fat-md-growth remedy is to shrink the CURRENT session's own new prose, or fold genuinely resolved rule-type content into a skill -- never archive an inherited section wholesale unless every wish inside it already has a real row

Measured 2026-09-09 in WKAppBot: archiving the 11th letter's full body relieved fat-md-growth but triggered WISH ERASED for 3 paragraphs whose wishes were not individually re-proven, forcing a full restore
author: claude
